g.text: Figure 1. Synthetic packet-rate trajectories and saved future-attack probability forecasts for three preselected validation episodes.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #445266

g.text: Gold shading identifies decision minutes with a positive H10 forecast target; it does not identify exact attack onset. The dotted 0.5 risk line is illustrative.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #586779

g.text: All curves are from aligned saved validation predictions. Examples are illustrative, not aggregate model performance or evidence of real-network deployment.
